Limits resource usage and prevents overwhelming servers with too many
simultaneous requests. Defaults to 10 if not specified.

servers.description: List of MCP servers to connect to

tool_timeout_secs.description:
Timeout for individual tool execution in seconds

Controls how long to wait for a tool call to complete before timing out.
Defaults to 30 seconds if not specified.

McpServerConfig.description:
Configuration for an individual MCP server

Defines connection parameters, authentication, and tool management
settings for a single MCP server instance.

bearer_token.description:
Optional Bearer token for authentication

Automatically included as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
for HTTP and WebSocket connections. Process connections typically
don't require authentication tokens.

enabled.description:
Whether this server should be activated

Disabled servers are ignored during client initialization.
Defaults to true if not specified.

id.description:
Unique identifier for this server

Used internally to track connections and route tool calls.
Must be unique across all servers in a single MCP client configuration.
Defaults to a UUID if not specified.

name.description:
Human-readable name for this server

Used for logging, debugging, and user-facing displays.

resources.description:
Optional resource URI patterns this server provides

Used for resource discovery and subscription.
Supports glob patterns like "file://**" for filesystem access.

tool_prefix.description:
Optional prefix to add to all tool names from this server

Helps prevent naming conflicts when multiple servers provide
tools with similar names. For example, with prefix "web",
a tool named "search" becomes "web_search".
Defaults to a UUID-based prefix if not specified.

oneOf.description:
HTTP-based MCP server using JSON-RPC over HTTP

Best for: Public APIs, RESTful services, servers behind load balancers
Features: SSE support, standard HTTP semantics, easy debugging

headers.description: Optional headers to include in requests (e.g., API keys, custom headers)

timeout_secs.description:
Optional timeout in seconds for HTTP requests
Defaults to no timeout if not specified.

url.description: Base URL of the MCP server (http:// or https://)

oneOf.description:
Local process-based MCP server using stdin/stdout communication

Best for: Local tools, development servers, sandboxed environments
Features: Process isolation, no network overhead, easy deployment

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command

env.description: Optional environment variables for the process

work_dir.description: Optional working directory for the process

oneOf.description:
WebSocket-based MCP server for real-time bidirectional communication

Features: Persistent connections, server-initiated notifications, minimal overhead

headers.description: Optional headers for the WebSocket handshake

timeout_secs.description:
Optional timeout in seconds for connection establishment

specific use cases and deployment scenarios.

reasoning_effort.description: Legacy schema field. Use `reasoning.effort` with the active Responses endpoint.

reasoning_enabled.description: Toggle reasoning output for models that support it.

reasoning_top_logprobs.description: Number of top logprobs to return for reasoning tokens.

oneOf.description: Force plain text or JSON-schema constrained output.
Sequences where generation stops.

store.description: Persist the response so it can be fetched later by ID.

stream.description: Stream the response as server-sent events.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; higher values increase randomness.

oneOf.description: Controls which (if any) tool the model must call.

top_k.description: Sample only from the k most likely tokens.

top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely tokens to return per position; requires `logprobs`.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling: only tokens within the top cumulative probability mass are considered.

truncate_sequence.description: Truncate inputs that exceed the model's context length instead of erroring.

device_layers.description: Layers per device, as `--device-layers` takes them: `ORD:NUM` entries, or one count for device 0.

disable_eos_stop.description: Generate to `max_tokens` regardless of end-of-sequence tokens, as a benchmark needs.

embeddings_on_host.description:
An untied token embedding lives in pinned host memory the GPU reads over the bus, out of VRAM, with identical
output; on unless set to false.

encoder_cache_memory_bytes.description: Byte budget for cached multimodal encoder outputs.

hf_config_overrides.description: Merged recursively into the model's `config.json` before it loads.

hf_revision.description: Hub revision (branch, tag or commit) of `model`; each entry of `models` names its own.

log.description: Appends each request and response to this file.

max_decode_steps_before_prefill.description: Decode steps the scheduler runs before admitting a waiting prefill.

max_num_batched_tokens.description: Most tokens one scheduler step batches across sequences; unset, 4096 or the prompt chunk if longer.

max_prefill_chunk_tokens.description:
Longest prompt chunk one prefill step takes; unset, 512, or for MoE experts in host memory the longest chunk the
expert cache leaves room for.

moe_expert_cache.description:
MoE experts (GGUF, on CUDA) stay in host memory with this many per layer cached on the GPU, the CPU running
the rest; unset keeps every expert in VRAM.

paged_attn.description: Paged attention: unset picks the device default.

prefix_cache_checkpoint_tokens.description:
Tokens between a long prompt's recurrent checkpoints in the host prefix cache, so a request that diverges early
in it (an edited earlier turn) redoes at most this many; default 16384, 0 keeps only the final ones.

prefix_cache_dir.description:
Directory that keeps prefix cache entries on disk, so long sessions survive eviction and restarts (hybrid
models on CUDA with paged attention); unset, and without `prefix_cache_ram_gib`, the cache stays in GPU memory.

prefix_cache_disk_gib.description: Most the prefix cache directory may hold, in GiB; the least recently used entries go first.

prefix_cache_disk_ttl_mins.description:
Minutes a host prefix cache entry (in memory or on disk) outlives its last use, unless its request names a TTL (an Anthropic
`cache_control` breakpoint, or `prefix_cache_ttl_secs`); default 60.

prefix_cache_n.description: Prefix cache capacity in sequences; 0 disables the prefix cache.

prefix_cache_ram_gib.description:
Host memory for prefix cache entries, in GiB: in front of `prefix_cache_dir`, or on its own without one;
unset or 0 keeps none in memory.

throughput_logging.description: Periodic throughput logging; on unless set to false.

SandboxLimits.description: Limits that replace a sandbox profile's; unset ones keep the profile's.

max_cpu_secs.description: Per-session CPU time cap in seconds; raised to the tool's timeout where rlimits apply.

SandboxMode.description: Whether tools that run model-written code are sandboxed.

SandboxPolicy.description: Policy applied to a sandboxed process.

extra_env.description:
Additional environment variable names allowed through the env scrub.
Appended to the built-in allowlist (PATH, LANG, ...). Names only,
values come from the parent process's environment.

extra_fs_read.description:
Additional filesystem paths the sandboxed process may read.
Appended to the built-in system allowlist.

extra_fs_write.description:
Additional filesystem paths the sandboxed process may read and write.
Appended to the per-session workdir.

max_cpu_secs.description: CPU-time cap in seconds where resource limits are supported.

max_file_sz_mb.description: Maximum file size in MB where resource limits are supported.

max_memory_mb.description: Address-space cap in MB where resource limits are supported.

max_open_fds.description: Open file descriptor cap where resource limits are supported.

max_procs.description: Child process cap where resource limits are supported.

oneOf.description: Network access granted to sandboxed subprocesses.

strict.description: When true, missing requested layers become hard errors.

SandboxProfile.description: The starting policy for sandboxed tools: `restricted` or `developer` (toolchain paths, full network by default).

SavedModel.description:
A load the manager keeps under its model id: the request its last successful load used, and whether the server
loads it again when it starts.

SavedModels.description: The loads the manager keeps, by model id.

SceneKind.description: Indoor scenes keep far distances; outdoor ones compress them.

SearchEmbeddingModel.description: Embedding model used for ranking web search results internally.

SerializedSession.description: Wire format. Images and video frames are base64 PNGs.

deleted.description: False when there was no such session.

SessionForkRequest.description: Branches a session into a new one, named by the engine, with the source's first `num_turns` turns (0 copies all).

SkillsSpec.description: Where uploaded skills are kept; requests reference them from the shell tool.

root.description:
Kept across loads and shareable between engines, each reading it as it was at load; without a root the engine
keeps its skills in a directory of its own that goes away with it.

SourceMeta.description: Which agentic tool produced the file, and when in the session.

tool_call_id.description: The id of the tool call that made the file.

SpeculativeStats.description: Speculative decoding counters for each loaded model, counted since it loaded; all zero without a proposer.

input.description: The text content to convert to speech.
input.example: [S1] Dia is an open weights text to dialogue model. [S2] You get full control over scripts and voices. [S1] Wow. Amazing. (laughs) [S2] Try it now on Git hub or Hugging Face.

model.description: The TTS model to use for audio generation.

phonemes.description: The model's own phoneme string, spoken in place of `input` (Kokoro; without it, `input` is phonemized).

response_format.description: The desired audio format for the generated speech.

seed.description: Seeds the model's sampling noise, so a request repeats exactly (Kokoro).

speed.description: Speaking rate, 1.0 being the model's own (Kokoro). Dia ignores it.

timestamps.description:
Answers with JSON (`SpeechWithTimestamps`): the audio in `response_format`, base64-encoded, and when each word
of `input` is spoken, with its IPA. Kokoro times words; another model answers with no words.

voice.description: A voice the model ships (Kokoro: e.g. `af_heart`; several, comma-separated, are blended). Dia ignores it.

SpeechGenerationSpec.description: Speech sampling for every generation of the loaded model; an unset field keeps the architecture's default.

speed.description: Kokoro's default speaking rate, which a request's `speed` overrides.

SpeechSegment.description: A span of speech, in seconds from the start of the audio.

SpeechWithTimestamps.description: The answer to a speech request with `timestamps`.

audio.description: The audio in the request's `response_format`, base64-encoded.

words.description: The input's words in order; empty for a model that can't time them.

SpeechWord.description: A word of a speech request's `input` and when it is spoken, in seconds from the start of the audio.

ipa.description: The word's canonical IPA, as the phonemizer read it; empty when it couldn't be placed on the word.

oneOf.description: Multiple possible stop sequences
Single stop sequence

StopTokens.description:
Stop token configuration for generation

Defines when the model should stop generating text, either with a single
stop token or multiple possible stop sequences.

oneOf.description: Format for text output
Plain text output
JSON output with optional schema

strict.description: Whether to use strict schema validation

oneOf.description: JSON object output

ToolCall.description:
Represents a tool call made by the assistant

This structure wraps a function call with its type information.

id.description: Unique identifier for this tool call

type.description: The type of tool being called

oneOf.description: Disallow selection of tools.
Allow automatic selection of any given tool, or none.
Require at least one tool call.

TranscriptionDelta.description: The text one push to a streamed transcription adds.

TranscriptionRequest.description: Speech recognition request; the audio itself travels beside it (a multipart `file` over HTTP).

beam_size.description: Beam search over this many hypotheses (1 to 16) for an RNN-T or TDT model; unset decodes greedily.

diarization_model.description:
A diarization model to run over the same audio: segments then break where the speaker changes, and segments
and words carry the speaker.

language.description: The audio's language (`de-DE`, `de`), for Nemotron-3.5; unset lets it identify the language. Parakeet ignores it.

model.description: The speech recognition model to use.

prompt.description: Text to steer the transcript; Parakeet ignores it.

temperature.description: Parakeet decodes greedily and ignores it.

timestamp_granularities.description: Timestamps `verbose_json` carries; segments are always given, words only when asked for.

TranscriptionResponseFormat.description: What a transcription answers with: OpenAI's formats.

TranscriptionSegment.description: A timed span of a transcript, about a sentence.

speaker.description: The diarizer's index of who speaks it, when the request named a `diarization_model`.

TranscriptionSessionRequest.description:
Opens a streamed transcription on a cache-aware streaming model: mono audio is pushed as it arrives and each push
returns the text it adds; an inference.rs extension.

language.description: As for [`TranscriptionRequest`]: a Nemotron-3.5 language, unset to identify it.

response_format.description: How the finished session's whole transcript is rendered.

sample_rate.description: The sample rate of the mono audio pushed; it is resampled to the model's.

TranscriptionWord.description: A timed word of a transcript, in seconds from the start of the audio.

speaker.description: The diarizer's index of who says it, when the request named a `diarization_model`.

dtype.description: Optional model dtype (auto, f16, bf16, etc)

max_batch_size.description: Optional max batch size for tuning

max_seq_len.description: Optional max sequence length for tuning

oneOf.description: Optional tuning profile

requested_isq.description: Optional fixed ISQ level to test (e.g., Q4K)

expected_generation.description: Remove only if the alias still points at this generation.

lora_int_id.description: Accepted for vLLM request compatibility; aliases are authoritative in inference.rs.

UqffWriteSpec.description: How a spec names a UQFF to write: an output path, or the path with the ISQ types and report metadata.

language.description: The language the model was told or identified (Nemotron-3.5, as `de-DE`); otherwise the request's, echoed.

VoiceActivityRequest.description:
Voice activity request; the audio travels beside it (a multipart `file` over HTTP). An unset field keeps the
reference `get_speech_timestamps` default.

max_speech_duration_s.description: Longer speech is split at its longest silence (unbounded).

min_silence_duration_ms.description: Silence shorter than this does not end speech (100).

model.description: The voice activity model to use.

neg_threshold.description: Probability under which speech may end (`threshold - 0.15`, at least 0.01).

return_probabilities.description: Also return the speech probability of every chunk.

speech_pad_ms.description: Padding on each side of a segment (30).

probabilities.description: Speech probability per chunk, when asked for.

extract_description.description: Override the description for the extraction tool.

search_description.description: Override the description for the search tool.

WorldJob.description: A world from a panorama, the job's one input.

oneOf.description: How much it may displace to run, in place of the server's setting

prompt.description: The caption every clip is generated with

oneOf.description: Decided by the sky found in the panorama when unset

splats.description: Train Gaussian splats on the result (on by default)
